notes: The owner: "each theme could have a subsection for the charts when that theme is selected. Would that make sense?" It does — and the 5.146.0 architecture made the settings half free: the drill-down rows derive from the registry's own group field, so six new group:'Charts' variables put a Charts heading in every palette's drill-down with NO client edit. - Six Charts vars (chart background, text, grid, scale border, candle up/down), defaults the INCUMBENT chart literals byte for byte; DarkBlue carries slate-blue surfaces with the candle semantics unchanged. - The chart document derives at emissi
